data: Is the height of the black bar at n=0 greater than the height of any other black bar in the figure?

The black bars represent the areas under the ROC-curves for different values of n. The height of each bar corresponds to the area value. The caption specifies that n* is represented as n=0. 

To determine if the height of the black bar at n=0 is greater than the height of any other black bar, I need to compare the heights of all the black bars in the figure. 

From the figure, the black bar at n=0 appears to be the tallest among all the bars. The heights of the other bars are either negative or close to zero, indicating that they are lower than the bar at n=0. Therefore, the height of the black bar at n=0 is indeed greater than the height of any other black bar in the figure.
Yes, the height of the black bar at n=0 is greater than the height of any other black bar in the figure.
